# Fraterny - Social Network & Quest Platform

> Professional social network for developers with introspection quest features
> Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase, TypeScript

## Quick Overview

**Domain**: https://fraterny.com
**Tech Stack**: Next.js App Router, Supabase Auth/DB, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion
**Key Features**: User authentication, Quest system, Blog, Payment integration, Admin dashboard

## Project Structure

```
/app                    # Next.js app router pages
  /auth                 # Authentication (login, signup)
  /quest                # Quest introspection system
  /blog                 # Blog with CMS
  /admin                # Admin dashboard
  /api                  # API routes
  /profile              # User profiles
  /payment-gateway      # Payment integration
  
/components             # Reusable React components
/lib                    # Utilities & configurations
/supabase               # Supabase client & types
/utils                  # Helper functions
/public                 # Static assets
```

## Core Technologies

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- **UI**: Radix UI, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Auth**: Supabase Auth
- **Forms**: React Hook Form + Zod
- **State**: React Query, Context API

## Key Routes

- `/` - Homepage
- `/auth/*` - Authentication flows
- `/quest/*` - Quest introspection experience
- `/blog/*` - Blog posts
- `/experience` - Platform experience
- `/profile/*` - User profiles
- `/admin/*` - Admin panel

## Environment Setup

Required environment variables:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`

## Development

```bash
npm run dev      # Start dev server (port 3000)
npm run build    # Production build
npm run start    # Start production server
```

## SEO Files

- `/robots.txt` - Search engine crawling rules
- `/sitemap.xml` - Site structure for indexing
- `/google-site-verification.html` - Google Search Console verification
